name: Microgrid capacitor-step coordination request

summary: Requests the assigned switched-capacitor stage under the documented supervisory strategy.
description: Requests the assigned switched-capacitor stage under the documented supervisory strategy. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reactive demand and bank availability” at the input and “Capacitor stage request” at the output. Switching duties and protection remain separately designed.
